verdicts.reason: A keeps 'Sunset Sessions' clearly dominant on the left, but the tagline is squeezed into a four-line sliver, 'Saturday 21 / June' breaks awkwardly, the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the badges, and the large missing-asset placeholder eats the right third. B has a jumbled reading order: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits at the very bottom, the date comes before the tagline, and the left edges of the text lines are ragged. Its logo is nearly invisible, the CTA is likewise reduced to a badge, and the placeholder plus fine print crowd the top-left, so the hierarchy is weaker than in A.
